plain_text:
VETERAN’S MEMORIAL COMMITTEE 
 
Meeting of the Veterans Memorial Committee was held on November 2, 2026 at Wallingford Town Hall 
Room 220. Chairman Ruth Palmer called the meeting to order at 1900. There were 6 members present.  
 
Minutes for previous meeting approved as submitted. 
 
This meeting is to continue planning Veterans Day service. 
 
Guest speak Joe Pajor was in attendance and spoke briefly.  
 
General discussion held regarding music and programs. 
 
We will meet in Council Chambers at 10 am on 11/11. 
 
Next meeting is November 9, 2026 at 1900 at Wallingford Town Hall Room 220.  
 
Meeting adjourned at 1936 after a moment of silence for departed members. 
 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
 
Elise M. Gallup 
Secretary
